prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universal “best” — the right HVAC company depends on where you are in Phoenix, whether it’s residential or commercial, how fast you need it fixed, your budget, the system brand/age, and whether you want a repair vs replacement. I can help you pick the best local option if you tell me a few details, or I can give general guidance so you can choose confidently.

Quick questions
- What ZIP code or neighborhood in Phoenix?
- Residential or commercial?
- Urgency: same-day/emergency or can wait for quotes?
- System age/brand and symptoms (not cooling, leaking, noisy, frozen evaporator, etc.)?
- Do you have any warranty or homeowner’s/HOA constraints?

How to choose the best company (short checklist)
- License and insurance: Ask for their Arizona Registrar of Contractors (ROC) license number and proof of insurance.
- Certifications: NATE-certified technicians and EPA 608 certification for refrigerant work are good signs.
- Local reputation: Look at recent Google/Yelp/Angie’s List reviews and BBB rating.
- Written estimate: Get at least 2–3 written quotes that list labor, parts, refrigerant type, and any diagnostic fee.
- Warranties: Ask length of parts & labor warranty and whether they honor manufacturer warranties.
- Upfront pricing & financing: Ask about diagnostic fee, service call fee, and whether financing or payment plans are offered.
- Availability: Same-day emergency service vs scheduled appointments.
- References: Ask for recent customer references in your area.

Important questions to ask a tech on the phone
- Are you licensed and insured? What’s your ROC number?
- Do you have NATE-certified techs?
- Do you charge a diagnostic fee if I hire you for the repair?
- What could be the likely causes based on my symptoms?
- How long for the work and what warranties do you provide?
- Do you handle permits if replacement is needed?

Red flags
- No license or refuses to provide it
- Wants full cash up front or only cash
- Vague answers about the problem or written estimate
- Unmarked vehicles or technicians who won’t show ID
- Pressure to replace when a repair seems reasonable

If you want, I can:
- Recommend top-rated companies near you (I’ll need your ZIP or neighborhood)
- Draft a message or phone script you can use when calling companies
- Help compare 2–3 quotes you receive

Which would you like me to do next? Provide your ZIP or describe the problem and urgency, and I’ll tailor recommendations.
